blurb: Bentley Arena hosts NCAA Division I hockey games and serves as a venue for career fairs, speakers, alumni events, and concerts. It is used as a living lab for students to analyze energy data and create marketing projects. The arena features sustainable design with solar panels, high-efficiency lighting, and recycled materials.
